Asha (CS): quick recap from Aurelia Health onboarding call — three recurring pain points + one feature ask that might affect renewal. can we triage?
Jordan (CS): pls paste notes when you have them
Asha (CS): notes: 1) SDK token rotation flow unclear in docs, multiple customers hit this during setup
Asha (CS): 2) need per-route cost transparency in console (finance wants to see cost by model/route)
Asha (CS): 3) default inference timeout fails on long-context prompts causing errors
Asha (CS): feature ask: ability to pin a model per customer in Dedicated (strong isolation)
Miguel (PM): high level thoughts: token docs = docs quick fix; cost visibility = product medium effort (UI + billing); timeout = infra/ops fix; model pinning = enterprise feature, potentially commercial. agree? :thinking_face:
Priya (Eng): timeout likely a runtime config we can expose per-deployment. small schema change + spike. estimate: 2-day spike then 3-5 dev days depending on rollout plan.
Sam (Solutions): model pinning is something we see with pilot customers — will need KMS/SSO and SLA scoping. I can draft SOW bullets.
Jordan (CS): renewal risk flagged as moderate for Aurelia — they want model pinning + billing clarity before Q4 decision. Jordan -> will escalate to AE.
Miguel (PM): proposed priority: docs fix P1 (quick), runtime timeout P1 (stability), per-route cost P2 (UX work), model pinning P0 (enterprise).
triage-bot: created ticket CS-8249 in product-triage with labels [aurelia,onboarding,renewal-risk]
Asha (CS): assigning owners: Jordan = docs, Priya = runtime spike, Miguel = roadmap & AE sync, Sam = enterprise scoping.
Priya (Eng): starting spike today, notes going in /docs/internal/runtime-timeouts.md. sample config idea:
Priya (Eng): ```yaml
runtime:
  default_inference_timeout_ms: 60000
  per_deployment_overrides: true
```
Jordan (CS): I'll draft a quick token-rotation how-to and a one-pager for AEs with screenshots. can someone paste the snippet customer used for rotation?
Asha (CS): I'll extract the snippet from the call recording and attach to CS-8249.
Miguel (PM): timeline check: can we get docs + spike notes by next Tue (1777770600)? if yes we can propose a PO change to bump timeout in the following sprint.
Priya (Eng): yes, spike + initial PR feasible by then.
Sam (Solutions): I'll outline enterprise pinning options and rough SOW by EOW and add to the ticket.
Asha (CS): next steps recap: Jordan share docs draft, Priya link spike doc, Miguel update renewal playbook entry. sync Fri standup if blockers. :thumbsup:
Miguel (PM): also tagging metric: mark any reopen with label "doc-token-rotation" so CS can measure reduction in support hits post-fix.
Jordan (CS): noted. thanks everyone.
